auth.title: Login Root !
auth.subtitle: Enter Your Private  Code
auth.codeHint: Your code is single-use and expires shortly after it is issued.
auth.codeHintMinutes: Your code is single-use and lasts about {minutes, plural, one {a minute} other {# minutes}}.
auth.codeHintSeconds: Your code is single-use and lasts about {seconds} seconds.
auth.codeSpent: That code can no longer be used. Enter a new one here once you have it.
auth.noAccessBody: This link can’t be opened. It may have expired, been used already, or never been valid. Ask a root administrator to issue you a new one — there is no other way in.
auth.noSessionBody: This browser has no sign-in in progress. If you opened your link in one app and then switched browsers, it was left behind — open the access link again, and stay in the browser it opens.
auth.sessionEndedBody: This wasn't something you did. Open your access link again to sign back in. If it no longer opens, ask a root administrator for a new one.
auth.sessionEndedNoLink: Open the access link from your WhatsApp message to sign back in.
auth.reenterPrompt: Refreshing this page won’t help — there is nothing here to reload.
auth.faceNoFace: Position your face inside the frame
auth.faceMultiple: Only one person in the frame, please
auth.faceOffCentre: Centre your face in the frame
auth.faceTooBright: Too bright — move out of direct light
auth.faceTooBlurry: Hold steady so the camera can focus
auth.faceCaptureFailed: Could not capture that. Try again.
auth.faceCameraBlocked: Camera access is blocked. Allow it in your browser, then open your access link again.
auth.deviceBody: Your account is protected by a passkey on this device. Confirm with your fingerprint, face or device PIN when your browser asks.
auth.deviceCancelled: That was cancelled, or this device has no passkey for this link.
auth.deviceUnsupported: This browser cannot use passkeys. Open the link in a current version of Chrome, Edge, Safari or Firefox.
auth.introBody: You Are Required To Identity Verification & Read And Agree To The Agreement And Terms Of Use.
auth.introConsent: Consent Constitutes A Full And Binding Commitment, And Shall Be Considered A Formal Legal Contract In Accordance With The Applicable Laws And Provisions. If You Do Not Agree, Please Refrain From Proceeding And Click “Disagree”.
auth.faceSetupFailed: Could not start the face check.
auth.faceCameraFramerate: This camera is too slow for the face check — it needs at least 15 frames per second. Use the phone hand-off instead, or try a device with a better camera.
auth.faceSetupFailedCode: Could not start the face check ({code}).
auth.faceRotateBody: The face check only runs in portrait. Rotate your tablet and it will start on its own.
auth.faceRotateManual: This browser will not turn the screen for you — please rotate the device by hand.
auth.matchComparing: AI is comparing your face with your ID…
auth.matchDone: ID Matching With Your Photo Done
auth.matchWrong: ID Matching With Your Photo Not Correct
auth.matchReview: Match accepted with low confidence — your verification will be reviewed by our team. Continuing to the next step…
auth.matchFailed: We noticed a discrepancy in the image and there is an issue with your verification.
auth.idMissingName: We couldn't read your full name. Move away from glare on the name and try again.
auth.idMissingBirthday: We couldn't read your date of birth. Keep that part of the card free of glare.
auth.idMissingDocumentNumber: We couldn't read your ID number. Keep that part of the card free of glare.
